# eon_restore_account_region_aws_instance_types (Data Source)

Retrieves the EC2 instance types available for restore in a restore account's region and subnet. Use this data source to select an instance type for `eon_restore_job`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: List EC2 instance types available for restore in a region and subnet
data "eon_restore_account_region_aws_instance_types" "demo" {
  restore_account_id = "e696c7f0-17c6-4d9b-b589-591293c00d36"
  region             = "us-east-1"
  subnet_id          = "subnet-0123456789abcdef0"
}

# Example: Size the lookup for a restore of two 50 GiB volumes
data "eon_restore_account_region_aws_instance_types" "sized" {
  restore_account_id = "e696c7f0-17c6-4d9b-b589-591293c00d36"
  region             = "us-east-1"
  subnet_id          = "subnet-0123456789abcdef0"
  volume_count       = 2
  total_volume_bytes = 107374182400
}

output "available_instance_types" {
  description = "EC2 instance types available for restore in the subnet"
  value       = data.eon_restore_account_region_aws_instance_types.demo.instance_types
}

output "instant_restore_host_for_m5_large" {
  description = "Instant-restore host instance type backing m5.large, if any"
  value       = try(data.eon_restore_account_region_aws_instance_types.demo.instant_restore_mapping["m5.large"], null)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region` (String) AWS region to list instance types for.
- `restore_account_id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the AWS restore account.
- `subnet_id` (String) ID of the subnet to get instance types for.

### Optional

- `total_volume_bytes` (Number) Sum of guest-volume sizes in bytes. Used to size the host-memory reserve. The server uses a default when omitted.
- `volume_count` (Number) Number of guest volumes planned to be restored. Used to size the host-memory reserve for instant-restore host selection. The server uses a default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `instance_types` (List of String) List of EC2 instance types available for restore.
- `instant_restore_mapping` (Map of String) Map from post-promotion instance type to instant-restore host instance type. Instance types present in `instance_types` but absent from this map have no instant-restore option in this availability zone.
